name: Guanhães (Brazil)
description: Green field crossed by a blue diagonal band rising from the lower hoist to the upper fly, with a yellow triangle in the upper hoist and three crossed white arrows in the lower fly.
history: Guanhães is a municipality in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil. The flag, designed by Laet Berto, is prescribed by Municipal Law No. 1,210 of 23 October 1975; it keeps the proportions and colours of the national flag, the triangle is the symbol of Minas Gerais, the blue diagonal the Guanhães river crossing the forests of the Doce valley and the arrows recall the indigenous origin of the area.

features.role: diagonal band for the Guanhães river
triangle of Minas Gerais, a heap of gold
three crossed arrows recalling the indigenous origin
